title: ClearFairy Cognitive Decision Step
description: A single inferred cognitive decision step from a designer's Figma session, as released by the ClearFairy dataset.

task_type.description: The design task the participant completed.

step_index.description: Zero-based ordinal position of the step within the participant's session.

decision_and_actions.description: LLM-generated description of the concrete actions the designer took during this step.

rationale.description: Reasoning behind the decision. Left as an empty string when no sufficiently grounded rationale could be established for the step, even if the designer offered some explanation. Empty in ~17% of records.

progression.description: LLM-inferred narrative of how this step fits into the broader design progression.
